summary: Lost Colony has its own ASA campaign and Red-Handed encounters with Lost King and Lost Queen. Map access requires the Lost Colony Expansion Pass.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.

steps.title: 1 · Establish a cold-weather base
steps.reason: Cold protection, supply reserves and transport sustain longer mission routes.

steps.title: 2 · Campaign access

steps.title: 3 · Prepare for Red-Handed
steps.reason: Lost King and Lost Queen belong to the map endgame. This guide has no verified minimum army stats; check the current encounter requirements before risking your breeding army.
